title: S48 — Parallelization: multi-threaded image processing pipeline
desc: Current pipeline is single-threaded. Implement: (1) parallel glyph extraction; (2) parallel template matching; (3) thread-safe result aggregation. Target: 2x speedup on multi-core systems. Owner: marcus-aurelius. Priority: 3.

history.note: Dropped: superseded by S39 (template re-rendering is the bottleneck, not threading).
